author: blu
body: Proves Howl from Beyond: "Target creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn." compiles to PumpXPower and is cast through the X-spell path. The fixed cost is paid first; cast-pump-x then pours ALL remaining mana into X and boosts the caster's biggest creature by +X/+0 to push combat damage. Here the caster has 2 mana left after the fixed cost and a 2/2 bear on board, so the bear becomes a 4/2. The spell goes to the graveyard and the mana pool empties into X.
